Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:192400
Court No. - 66

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 44970 of 2024
Applicant :- Rafsan

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Shamshida Tyagi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1. Heard Sri Gulfan Ali Advocate holding brief of Ms. Shamshida Tyagi, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Rajiv Dhar Dwivedi, learned AGA for the State-respondent.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
25 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 326B, 504 and 506 IPC & Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Muzaffarnagar, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

entities.text: Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Muzaffarnagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is husband of the victim and on the basis of false allegations, he has been made accused in the present matter alongwith other family members including his younger brother i.e. co-accused Aquib.

4. He further submitted that there is specific allegation against co-accused Aquib that he threw some chemical upon the victim i.e. informant of the case and after considering entire facts of the case,
Aquib has already been released on bail by this Court and his bail order has been annexed as annexure-6 to the affidavit and considering the role assigned to the co-accused Aquib, case of the Rafsan vs State Of U.P. on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189886107/
1 applicant who is however husband of the victim is on far better footing than him.
5.

He further submitted that even during investigation when applicant approached this Court under section 438 Cr.P.C. then this Court on 16.5.2023 was pleased to enlarge him on anticipatory bail and order dated 16.5.2023 passed by this Court is annexed as annexure 7 to the affidavit.

He next submitted that but when after investigation charge sheet was submitted then anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant was withdrawn and thereafter applicant was surrendered and was sent to jail.
6. He further submitted that applicant is having no criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 30.7.2023.

7. Per contra, learned AGA, however, opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of the victim and victim also sustained some chemical injury but could not dispute the fact that role of causing chemical injuries has been assigned by the victim to the co-accused Aquib i.e.
younger brother of the applicant and co-accused Aquib has already been released on bail by this Court.
8.

He further could not dispute that during investigation applicant was on interim anticipatory bail and after submission of the chargesheet his anticipatory bail which was pending before this Court was withdrawn and thereafter he surrendered before the court concerned and was sent to jail in the present matter.
9.
He further could not dispute the fact that applicant ishavingno criminal history and in the present matter applicant is in jail since 7.8.2024 i.e for last more than 4 months.
10. I have heard learned counsel for both the sides and perused the record of the case.

11. However, applicant is husband of the victim i.e. informed of the case and there is allegation that he alongwith his other family members tortured her for demand of dowry and its also reflects that wife of the applicant i.e. informant of the case sustained some chemical injuries too but record further suggests that role of causing chemical burn injuries have been specifically attributed to the co-accused Aquib i.e. younger brother of the applicant and after considering entire facts and circumstances of the case, he has already been released on bail by this Court.

12. Further, from the record it also reflects that during investigation this Court enlarged the applicant on interim anticipatory bail and after submission of the chargesheet the anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant was withdrawn and thereafter he surrendered and was sent to jail and there is no evidence that during investigation while he was on interim anticipatory bail he misused the liberty of anticipatory bail granted to him.
13. Further, applicant is having no criminal history and in the present matter, he is in jail since 7.8.2024 i.e. for last more than 4 months.

Rafsan vs State Of U.P. on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189886107/
2 14.

Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
15. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

16. Let the applicant-Rafsan, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
17. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

18. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 9.12.2024 Ankita  Rafsan vs State Of U.P. on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189886107/
